_comment: Sample remote availability config for the ProphetX integration.
Host this somewhere editable without shipping an app release and point
PROPHETX_CONFIG_URL at it. The client fails closed: if this cannot be
fetched and nothing valid is cached, ProphetX is not surfaced.
region_gating  when true, allowed_regions is enforced and an unknown
region is denied. Set false only for a genuinely
allowed_regions  two-letter codes, case-insensitive. Ships EMPTY on
purpose: ProphetX has not supplied a jurisdiction list,
and inventing one would be worse than having none.
note           free text, surfaced in logs for whoever is on call.
note: Pre-launch. Awaiting Market Data API access and a jurisdiction list from ProphetX.
